entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller. Order is 775-1B. The cycling shoes.

Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand correctly and can help you best, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They gave me blisters. I guess that's a 'preference' for not having them.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Did you have a chance to adjust the placement of the cleats at all? Sometimes a small adjustment can make a big difference in comfort.
I tried. They just don't fit right. I just want a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I see the delivery was 13 days ago, and our policy allows for returns on these items within 90 days. You're well within that window, so we can definitely process this for you.
Fine. So what do I do?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Great. You should see that email in your inbox shortly. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience in the future. Have a good day.
